why_this_is_the_blocker: Every evaluation cycle since 43531218191 has had its team job succeed and its independent-audit job die at the 2700 s wrapper quantum (exit 78). No audit ref has ever been written for this chain, so no snapshot can be promoted. The producer surface is therefore the lever: the audit must be able to reach a verdict from a read-only fast path well inside the quantum, without exploring the repository.
